name: Bleachers (3 rows)
placement: On level ground facing a field, stage or yard; 15 ft section seats about 36; keep clear space at the front and back.
modeling: Three stepped plank rows of boxes 4.57 x 0.25 x 0.04 m at heights 0.25, 0.51 and 0.76 m, stepped back 0.5 m each, with riser boxes below, end frames from thin boxes, and a footboard in front.
